notes_for_editor: Thin record. The GA list is the only tower-specific source. No source dates the tower, gives its height or design, describes staffing or fires, or says whether it stands; the story says the site today is undocumented and does not guess. The name 'odum old' may mean it is the older of two Odum towers (the other is GA179 'odum', gfc-807, about 3.1 km north-north-west), but no source says so and the story does not claim it. Not retrieved: NGS datasheet BS1567 (the NGS lookup page returned a generic listing, not the sheet). Mapcarta's 'Old Odum Water Tower' is a different structure about 0.6 km west; it appears only as a warning against confusion. Check whether a separate record for the GA179 'odum' entry exists and whether it should be linked. Searches used: 2. Pages read: about 5.
